reviews.text: We had the best experience at Livewell! They took fantastic care of our sweet cats. They are fear free certified and we are so happy to have a place so close to take care of our babies.

Had a wonderful experience bringing my senior Beagle, Clyde, in for his first visit! From the moment we arrived, the entire team was incredibly warm, welcoming, and attentive.

What impressed me most was how everyone took the time to let Clyde explore the exam room, sniff around, and get comfortable before beginning his examination. Everyone was so gentle and patient with him, giving him plenty of affection (and pup cups and lots of treats!) along the way.

I’ve genuinely never seen Clyde so calm and relaxed during a veterinary appointment, which says a lot about the care and compassion of the staff. Dr. Mundahl was thorough, informative, and made the entire experience feel comfortable and reassuring.

It’s such a relief knowing my senior pup is in good hands. We’re grateful to have found such a wonderful team! I highly recommend for pups of all ages but particularly if you have a senior pet and are looking for someone knowledgeable with that age group.

Great service wonderful staff and very convenient far as location as well.And they'll see you on the spot and to take care of your best friends needs my Frizzy was wel coming to staff and that's rare he isn't to much of a people's person but he sence the gentleness of the staff.I recommend livewell animal hospital to everyone and prices are low and they have 10 percent discount towards visit
Awesome vet in Fishtown. Highly recommend
Our experience at Livewell was awesome! Everyone there is so nice and our pup Griz had a great experience. Thanks for taking care of him.
Calm, informative , and gentle care in my vet visit with my dachshund. She loved them and made it a positive experience. She says thank you for the free pup cups!
The service was AWESOME and so was the staff. Mikayla(sorry abt the spelling) Rose and the Vet are all so attentive and friendly. Excited to call this my pup's new vet for all her needs :)
Amazing experience

Beautiful vet office, very friendly and passionate staff. They were able to get my cat in for an emergency appointment. They were very communicative about pricing which I really appreciate. We will definitely be back!
Had to bring my cat in for a check up and the experience was smooth and easy. Very appreciative of their care and kindness.
Amazing experience! Easy to book and great staff!
They saw my dog in a jiffy! Amazing bedside manner, very knowledgeable and sweet, very caring..looks like we found our new neighborhood vet!
Amazing experience, my pup Alfredo loved every moment and treat. The facility is clean and the staff really made him feel comfortable. Looking forward to coming back!!
It’s a good place to take your pet the helped my puppy out a lot I really recommend it
Sherrie was awesome. Most relaxed my cat has EVER been at the vet. They were great

Very kind and professional staff. My pup was pretty comfortable with them and they were super sweet to her. They gave her a pupcup and snacks which helped the nerves.

Quick and easy. Would come here again
Best vet office to hit the town in years! From the second we walked in the door everyone was very accommodating, hospitable and transparent through every aspect of my fur baby’s care.

Took my cat, Peanut, to the vet for a wellness check, the experience was wonderful. This pet hospital is very nice and the staff are attentive and professional. Michaela and Dr. Mundhal were great with answering all of our questions and gave us great advice for keeping our cats weight down. We cant wait to take the rest of the kitties here! Highly recommend.
I came for a wellness check and the staff were super friendly and welcoming.

Had our first visit to Livewell Animal Hospital today and the staff and service are exceptional. They took care of my sweet & nervous girl - I know she is in good hands! The vet, vet techs, and vet assistants are all professional and wonderful. The exam was thorough and well done. Would highly recommend!

Had our first appointment today with my 1.5 year old puppy. Everyone was extremely nice and accommodating, the environment is very calm and welcoming. My puppy is a bit nervous around new people and everyone went above and beyond to make sure she was comfortable and cared for.

Just took my 16 year-old rescue cat Poe
To be shaved and examined and have his nails clipped. He could not have been in better hands.! His fur was extremely nodded. He had an impacted front claw. He really needed love and extra care and he received it in abundance would highly recommend.

Today I took my dog Frankie into Livewell Animal Hospital with an ear infection. Frankie is generally extremely scared when going to the vet and starts shaking instantly upon entry, but today was MUCH different. When we walked into the door we were greeted by all of the staff making him feel extremely comfortable and it was such a pleasant experience. 100% would recommend!!!!
First time here and they were so accommodating to my nervous boy.  Amazing staff!!!
Took great care of my little man! Great, helpful service and good pricing. Gladly talked through all options for treatment and came up with a plan together.

Amazing time with Sherri, Michaela and Dr.Mundahl getting my first visit in. I had a nice big room, they gave me 3 pup cups and lots of treats. All the love i get makes me feel safe and the let Mama stay with me. Thanks Livewell!

So happy that Livewell Animal Hospital is open! Dr. Mundahl, and techs Sherri & Michaela are all incredibly professional, gentle, and knowledgeable in both caring for pets and how they approach people. The front desk folks were also super warm and the check in was easy. Today, they helped me get a little street cat that I rescued cleaned up and proper testing for a very fair price. I will be bringing my other two cats here, as well. Thanks, all!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had such a great experience with Livewell Pets! Everyone was incredibly sweet and gentle with our new puppy, Harold. They were efficient and thorough, carefully checked all of his records, and made the whole visit feel easy and reassuring. I was really happy with how kindly they handled Harold and with the care we received. Highly recommend!
Saw a few staff members the other day and they told me I had to stop in for George’s first vet visit. Came today and he was so loved. He’s obsessed with the salmon treats. You feel warmth here!!
